label: nyiso 81 floor rederive
definition: nyiso-81 (KEEPER REINSTATEMENT): the four curated NYC/LI ST_GAS reliability-floor limbs re-derived on the guard-corrected campd-unit-outages-NYISO.csv (6a8f285, economic-layup fix) under rule 23's sanctioned source-data trigger — NYC persistent base 0.496->0.175 / ramp base 0.533->0.185, LI persistent base 0.436->0.262 / ramp base 0.572->0.350, cap knot 37.55C/0.882 — closing the nyiso-80-isolated derive/apply coupling (coefficients derived on one extract vintage, floor applied against another) at its root; plus dual_fuel_oil_daily_parity armed (measured EIA NY Harbor ULSD daily, mean-preserving, zero fitted scalars, ~+$0.10/MWh). vs the drifted control (nyiso-79): D-1 ST_GAS cv_ratio 0.439/0.489/0.547 -> 0.835/0.948/0.826 (all >> the 0.50 gate), D-2 ST_GAS forced share 43.0/53.8/40.5% -> 28.9/36.2/25.8% (2024 the one over-budget year, GROUNDED under rubric v2.2: D-4 clears, D-1 passes), C3a all-PASS +4.7/-4.1/-8.4%, C3b all-PASS 0.128/0.176/0.185. C1 13/14 (parity with the de-designated keeper): its 2024 ST_GAS -3.02 fail is FIXED (-2.36 PASS); 2023 CC_REGULAR slipped -1.98 -> -4.11 vs a +/-2.94 band (the known downstate ST/CC mix boundary, open item). C3c tail thinner than actual in all years (3/0/9 vs 10/12/42; identical to the control — a current-main property, the corrected extract removed phantom outage-driven scarcity, not this change). Determination NOT-YET (C1 + C3c), same class as every prior NYISO keeper; promoted as the most structurally faithful run producible on current main (rule 1).
market_story: ST_GAS: NYC/LI steam runs around the clock because in-city / cable-islanded load pockets carry an NYISO local-reliability commitment (in-city must-run charter) — the floor sizes that commitment at the measured when-available cool-day CF of the committed fleet (p25), derived and applied on the SAME corrected outage extract, so laid-up capacity neither inflates the target nor hides inside the denominator; the evening hot-limb ramps commitment up with zone TMAX exactly as the measured CAMPD temperature->CF response does. CC_REGULAR: downstate combined cycle takes the energy the steam floor no longer over-claims — the 2023 merit inversion (control: ST_GAS 17.2 TWh / CC 25.8) unwinds to the economic order (9.9 / 31.2). CT_PEAKER: evening-ramp-windowed commitment only (h14-21, immaterial class <2% of load). Dual-fuel gas units cap at DAILY NY Harbor ULSD parity in winter — the measured intra-month distillate profile, not a flat monthly plateau.
